title: MILC Metaverse
role: Lead Designer, Game and Level Design
owned: Designed approximately 52 interactive environments and reusable systems for a commercial real-time platform, and gave day-to-day direction across gameplay programming, graphic design, backend and 3D.
brief: Redo the whole world that another company had made for the platform, as a commercial space where every environment has business logic at its core, built to bring visitors in and lead them to the brand.
problem: The space, landscape and buildings had to be re-designed under strict rules of world logic and metrics, with a product design document and an art bible, while serving commercial briefs.
approach: Re-designed the space, landscape, lighting, 3D buildings and the level design inside them.
result: A live commercial platform with branded environments, approximately 52 of them designed by me.
reflection: Designing for conversion is the same muscle as designing for a core loop: you're still guiding a player toward a goal they choose to pursue.
summary: Designed about 52 interactive environments and reusable systems for a commercial real-time platform.

gallery.alt: Two client-specific modular commercial environments: a bright teal showroom with display screens and a white boutique hall with a branded wall.
gallery.caption: Client-specific modular commercial environments, built with the catwalk and boutique functionality I created for branded environments.

gallery.alt: Aerial views of the MILC world: a sandy island with a central tower, and a coastal area with high-rise buildings.
gallery.caption: Commercial spaces integrated into the wider world, which I re-designed together with the buildings and the level design inside them.

approachItems: Re-designed and uplifted the whole space, landscape and lighting.
Complete 3D modelling of the buildings, and the level design inside them.
World logic and metrics, a product design document and an art bible, which I also created.
Modular catwalk and boutique workflows used for branded environments, including Karl Lagerfeld, Marc Cain and Leandro Lopes.
